headlines.description: — Fraser Minten and Casey Mittelstadt each had a goal and two assists and the Boston Bruins beat the Philadelphia Flyers 6-3 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bruins dominate Flyers 6-3 behind Minten and Mittelstadt with a goal and two assists each

events.name: Los Angeles Kings at Buffalo Sabres

headlines.description: — Alex Tuch had his fourth career hat trick to push his season goals total to 22, leading the surging Buffalo Sabres to a 4-1 victory over the Los Angeles Kings on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alex Tuch has 4th career hat trick in the Sabres' 4-1 victory over the Kings

headlines.description: — Nick Suzuki scored power-play and short-handed goals and added an assist to help the Montreal Canadiens beat the struggling Colorado Avalanche 7-3 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nick Suzuki leads Canadiens in 7-3 home romp over struggling Avalanche

events.name: Winnipeg Jets at Tampa Bay Lightning

headlines.description: — Darren Raddysh and Yanni Gourde each had a goal and two assists to lead the Tampa Bay Lightning to a 4-1 victory over the Winnipeg Jets on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Raddysh, Gourde and Kucherov help surging Lightning beat Jets 4-1

events.name: Nashville Predators at New Jersey Devils

headlines.description: — Nico Hischier scored 42 seconds into overtime to give the Devils a 3-2 win over the Nashville Predators on Thursday night after New Jersey's Jack Hughes left the game in the first period and didn't return.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hischier scores 42 seconds into OT, Devils beat Predators 3-2 after Jack Hughes leaves in 1st period

events.name: New York Islanders at New York Rangers

headlines.description: — Carson Soucy scored against the team that traded him 72 hours earlier,
headlines.shortLinkText: Islanders' Carson Soucy scores against his former team in 2-1 victory over Rangers

headlines.description: — Egor Chinakhov and Anthony Mantha scored on rushes in a 31-second span in Pittsburgh's four-goal second period, helping the Penguins beat the Chicago Blackhawks 6-2 on Thursday night for their fifth straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Penguins have 4-goal 2nd period to rout Blackhawks 6-2 for 5th straight win

headlines.description: — Jordan Staal's goal with 29.4 seconds left gave the Carolina Hurricanes three goals in the final two minutes for a 5-4 victory over the Utah Mammoth on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jordan Staal scores in final minute to cap late 3-goal rally by Hurricanes for 5-4 win over Mammoth

events.name: Washington Capitals at Detroit Red Wings

headlines.description: — Patrick Kane became the highest-scoring United States-born player in NHL history in the Detroit Red Wings' 4-3 loss to the Washington...
headlines.shortLinkText: Kane passes Modano for most points by US-born NHL player in Red Wings' 4-3 shootout loss to Capitals

events.name: Florida Panthers at St. Louis Blues

headlines.description: — Jimmy Snuggerud scored on a power play with 7.6 seconds left to give the St. Louis Blues a 5-4 victory over Florida on Thursday night, spoiling Matthew Tkachuk's best game in his return from adductor muscle surgery.
headlines.shortLinkText: Snuggerud scores late power-play goal, Blues beat Panthers to end 5-game skid

headlines.description: — Danila Yurov and Vinnie Hinostroza scored in the first period and the Minnesota Wild went on to beat the Calgary Flames 4-1 Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gustavsson makes 29 saves as the Wild race to an early lead and beat the Flames 4-1

events.name: San Jose Sharks at Edmonton Oilers

headlines.description: — Zach Hyman scored 1:06 into overtime after Evan Bouchard tied it with 59 seconds left in regulation as the Edmonton Oilers stormed back from a three-goal deficit in the third period to beat the San Jose Sharks 4-3 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Oilers rally from 3-goal deficit in the third period to stun Sharks in overtime 4-3

headlines.description: — Nikita Tolopilo made 32 saves, Drew O’Connor opened the scoring with 9:42 left and the Vancouver Canucks beat the Anaheim Ducks 2-0 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tolopilo makes 32 saves in Canucks' 2-0 win over Ducks, but doesn't get credit for shutout

events.name: Dallas Stars at Vegas Golden Knights

headlines.description: — Jason Robertson and Mikko Rantanen scored in the shootout and Dallas escaped with a 5-4 victory over the Golden Knights after the Stars blew a three-goal lead in the third period Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stars win 5-4 in shootout after blowing 3-goal lead to Golden Knights

events.name: Toronto Maple Leafs at Seattle Kraken

headlines.description: — Shane Wright scored twice and the Seattle Kraken extended their winning streak to three games with a 5-2 victory over the Toronto Maple Leafs on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Shane Wright scores twice as Kraken extend win streak to 3 games with 5-2 win over Maple Leafs
